test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question: Ravi & Raghav complete a certain work in 25 days. If both started working together & Ravi left after 15 days, then Raghav do the remaining work in 20 days. How many days Raghav will take to complete the same work alone?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let total work is 1 unit.

One day work of Ravi & Raghav = 1/25

15 days work of Ravi & Raghav = 15/25 = 3/5

Remaining work = 1 - 3/5 = 2/5 unit

Now, 2/5 of work by Raghav is completed in 20 days

1 unit work is completed in (5/2) × 20 = 50 days

**∴ Raghav will complete the work alone in 50 days.**
